extDescription.message: Translate web pages and show the translation below the original text, using Microsoft or Google Translate (no key needed) or your own OpenAI-compatible API.

cmdToggle.message: Translate this page / show original only

popupNotConfigured.message: Set your API key in Settings first.

errNoApiKey.message: API key is not set. Open the extension settings.

errRateLimited.message: $SERVICE$ is limiting requests from this connection (HTTP 429). The extension pauses for $SECONDS$ s, but the service may keep blocking you for longer. Switch the translation engine in the settings, or try another network.

engineHintMicrosoft.message: Works without an API key. It uses an unofficial endpoint behind the Edge browser translation feature, so heavy use may be limited for a while and it can stop working without notice. The text you translate is sent to Microsoft.

engineHintGoogle.message: Works without an API key. It uses the unofficial endpoint of the Google Translate website, which blocks a connection (HTTP 429) quite readily when requests pile up. If it does, switch to Microsoft. The text you translate is sent to Google.

engineHintOpenai.message: Translates with the OpenAI-compatible API you configure. Extra instructions (tone, terminology) are supported, and the text is sent only to the API address below.

optBaseUrlHint.message: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or http://localhost:11434/v1 (Ollama).

optApiKeyHint.message: Stored only in this browser's local extension storage. Leave empty for local servers.

optExtraPromptPlaceholder.message: e.g. Use a formal tone. Keep technical terms in English.

optAutoHint.message: One domain per line, e.g. news.ycombinator.com. Subdomains are included.

optInvalidUrl.message: The API base URL must start with http:// or https://

optPrivacy.message: The text of pages you translate is sent only to the translation engine you chose (Microsoft, Google, or the OpenAI-compatible API endpoint you configured), and nowhere else.
